subject: Dedicated capacity pricing follow-up — GPU type & reserved size (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for the call — follow-ups on dedicated capacity sizing & pricing

Kyle — thanks for a great intro call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary workload: generative chat for triage + follow-up content (few-shot prompts).
- Typical volume estimate: ~20M tokens/day average, with spikes up to ~50M tokens/day during peak campaigns.
- Embeddings usage: relatively low ~1M tokens/day (offline batch).
- Latency SLO: 95th pct under 300ms for short prompts (seq ~128) for the user-facing chat flow.
- Initial deployment preference: private/dedicated for data isolation, discuss VPC options later.

Open items for pricing/ sizing we discussed (can you confirm these):
1) Target throughput: how many concurrent requests / queries-per-second do you expect for the chat flow at peak? (we used tokens/day but want qps for sizing)
2) Preferred GPU family: you mentioned you prefer H100s for perf — is that a hard requirement or a preference if price/availability allows?
3) Budget range: you said there’s a monthly budget range — can you confirm a soft target (e.g., $/month or $/1M tokens target)?

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll loop in pricing and infra (vanessa + marcus) to propose two options: a lower-cost reserved config (4x A100 profile) and a higher-throughput config (8x H100 profile) with expected monthly committed cost and modeled $/1M tokens.
- We’ll attach a short appendix with unit economics (tokens -> GPU-hours mapping) and assumptions.
- If that looks good, can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your procurement team next week to get an official quote and contract timeline?

Attaching a quick template for the numbers we need (see attached acme_usage_estimates.xlsx).

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call — follow-ups on dedicated capacity sizing & pricing

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap, that matches what we discussed. Answers inline: 

1) Throughput: peak concurrent ~180-220 qps for chat (short prompts ~128 tokens), sustained baseline ~60 qps. If helpful, think of it as ~3k-6k qpm at peak.
2) GPU: H100 is preferred because we run a production transformer with heavy KV cache and want headroom for 2-3x concurrency. Not an absolute blocker if A100 gives a much better price point, but H100 would be ideal.
3) Budget: we have a target ceiling of ~$18k/month for the first phase. For unit economics, our finance team indicated a target of roughly $12-$15 per 1M tokens (we'd prefer closer to $12).

Procurement is cc’d — they’ll want a formal quote and SOC2/compliance docs. Happy to set up a follow-up early next week.

Thanks — Kyle

Kyle Morgan
Head of Product, Acme Health
kyle.morgan@acmehealth.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity follow-ups — Acme Health (pricing ask)

Vanessa / Marcus — forwarding Kyle’s reply (see below). Key asks from the customer:
- Baseline 60 qps, peak 180-220 qps (seq ~128), ~20M tokens/day average, spikes to 50M/day.
- Prefer H100 if we can get them near their budget but target is $18k/month and unit economics target ~$12/1M tokens.
- They want a formal quote + SOC2 docs; procurement is looped.

Can you please: 
1) Produce two alternate committed-reserved configurations (monthly cost + assumptions):
   a) Lower-cost: 4x A100 equivalent reserved pool (with autoscale/burst to hosted if needed) and expected $/1M tokens.
   b) Perf-first: 8x H100 reserved pool (or 4x H100 if we think 8x is overkill) with expected $/1M tokens and latency profile.
2) Call out how autoscale/burst would work for the spike to 50M tokens/day (cost impact).
3) Prepare a short one-page appendix on how we translate tokens -> GPU hours (assumptions: model type, seq len 128, avg tokens per request, KV cache hit rate).

Customer is pushing for $12/1M tokens target; if that’s infeasible, propose a rollover/commit structure that gets them to that number after X months.

Can we aim to get a quote packet (pdf) + SOC2 link by Tuesday so I can share with procurement?

Thanks — Marissa
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity follow-ups — Acme Health (pricing ask)

Looping in initial numbers — attaching a short pricing packet (redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf). Topline: 

Assumptions: model = open-arch transformer similar to Llama-3-70B perf profile, seq=128 average, KV cache effectiveness ~35% for their chat flow. We used their 20M tokens/day baseline and 50M spike.

Option A — Cost-conscious (4x A100 equivalent reserved):
- Config: 4x A100-80GB reserved + autoscale burst to hosted.
- Committed monthly: $24,000/month.
- Modeled unit cost: ~$18 per 1M tokens (baseline).
- Latency: 95p ~250-400ms depending on concurrency; handles baseline comfortably, limited headroom on sustained peaks.

Option B — Performance (4x H100 reserved, recommend 4x to start):
- Config: 4x H100 reserved + autoscale to additional H100 in burst (if required).
- Committed monthly: $36,500/month.
- Modeled unit cost: ~$11.5 per 1M tokens at baseline volumes (this reaches their target near $12/1M).
- Latency: 95p ~140-220ms for seq=128 at target concurrency; better headroom for spikes.

Notes:
- 8x H100 is likely over-provisioned for their stated peak (gives big headroom but higher fixed cost ~$73k/mo).
- If procurement’s target is $18k/mo, a potential path: start with 4x A100 at $24k/mo plus a 6‑month commit discount ladder that steps down unit price to ~$12/1M after meeting usage thresholds. We can structure a hybrid commit (reserved + usage credits) to meet their finance constraints.

Attached: redwood_dedicated_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing packet stub). I’ll prepare a one-pager on tokens -> GPU-hours for the appendix; Marcus can validate the KV cache assumptions.

— Vanessa
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
